text:
Predicates:
PrivateUniversity(x) ::: x is a private university.
IvyLeagueUniversity(x) ::: x is an Ivy League university.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
MovedTo(x, y) ::: x moved to y.
ValuedAt(x, y) ::: x was valued at y dollars.
OrganizedInto(x, y) ::: x has been organized into y.
ResidentialCollege(x) ::: x is a residential college.
School(x) ::: x is a school.
List(x, y) ::: x is a list of y.
Premises:
PrivateUniversity(Yale) ∧ IvyLeagueUniversity(Yale) ∧ ResearchUniversity(Yale) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
MovedTo(Yale, NewHaven) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven in 1716.
ValuedAt(YaleEndowment, 42.3Billion) ::: Yale university's endowment was valued at $42.3 billion.
OrganizedInto(Yale, 27CollegesAndSchools) ∧ List(ResidentialColleges, YaleColleges) ∧ List(GraduateSchoolOfArtsAndSciences, YaleColleges) ∧ List(ProfessionalSchools, YaleColleges) ::: Yale University has been organized into 27 constituent colleges and schools: the residential colleges, the Yale Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, and twelve professional schools.
Conclusion:
ResidentialCollege(Pierson) ∧ List(ResidentialColleges, YaleColleges) ::: Pierson College is a residential college at Yale.
